show.title: Behind the Margins
description: How do businesses really make money—and what’s left after the bills are paid?

Behind the Margins is a student-led podcast exploring business models through conversations with founders, CEOs and business leaders. We unpack revenue, costs, pricing and profit margins to understand what makes a business work.
From familiar brands to unexpected ventures, discover the decisions, challenges and trade-offs behind the numbers.
For students, aspiring entrepreneurs and anyone curious about business.

episodes.title: Behind the Margins of a French restaurent in KL - Episode 1
summary: In our first episode, we sit down with Firmin Rieu, a French chef and entrepreneur running a French restaurant in Malaysia, to follow the money through a business most of us only see from the dining table.

We explore how his costs and profit margins compare with industry benchmarks, how he manages staff turnover, and how his customer base shapes revenue. Discover what it takes to turn a passion for food into a profitable business.
